```{r}
#temperature_instrument$HDD_excess_instrument

  geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= gen_tot/10**3, color = "Elec Demand"))+

  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~. *1000, name = "Elec Demand(MWh)")) +
```

On regarde si c'est vrai aussi à l'ordre 1

```{r}


library(forecast)
library(pracma)
cor(plot_data$gen_tot, plot_data$T_avg)
cor(plot_data$gen_tot, plot_data$T_avg)
cor(log(plot_data$gen_tot), plot_data$T_avg)

cor(plot_data$gen_tot, plot_data$cold_excess_instrument)
cor(plot_data$gen_tot, plot_data$heat_excess_instrument)
cor(log(plot_data$gen_tot), plot_data$cold_excess_instrument)


diff_col <- c("T_avg" , "T_min","T_max" , "gen_tot",                
"cold_excess_instrument", "heat_excess_instrument")
for (col in diff_col){
  name <- paste0("diff_",col)
  plot_data[name] <- c(NA,diff(as.numeric(plot_data[[col]])))

}


plot_data <- na.omit(plot_data)

cor(plot_data$diff_gen_tot, plot_data$diff_cold_excess_instrument)
cor(plot_data$diff_gen_tot, plot_data$diff_T_avg)


vars_list <-c("diff_gen_tot", "diff_T_avg",
              "gen_tot", "T_avg")


adjusted_data <- list()
for (var in vars_list) {
  ts_data <- ts(plot_data[[var]], start = start_date, frequency = frequency)
  # Perform STL decomposition
  stl_fit <- stl(ts_data, s.window = "periodic")
  
  # Extract the seasonally adjusted component
  adjusted_data[[var]] <- seasadj(stl_fit)
}

# Combine the seasonally adjusted data into a dataframe
seasonally_adjusted_df <- as.data.frame(adjusted_data)

cor(seasonally_adjusted_df$diff_gen_tot, seasonally_adjusted_df$diff_T_avg)
cor(log(seasonally_adjusted_df$gen_tot), seasonally_adjusted_df$T_avg)
  
```

#Partie Supply

## Renewable instruments

```{r}
colnames(IV_data)
my_plot <- ggplot(IV_data)+
  #geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= T_year_month, color = "Temperature"))+
  geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= spot_price, color = "Elec Price"))+
  geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= renewable_generation/100, color = "Renew Gen"))+
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~. *100, name = "Elec Price")) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Price($)", color = "legend")+
  theme_minimal()

my_plot

```

```{r}

library(forecast)
library(pracma)
cor(IV_data$spot_price, IV_data$renewable_generation)
cor(IV_data$spot_price, IV_data$renewable_generation)
cor(log(IV_data$spot_price), IV_data$renewable_generation)

for (col in colnames(IV_data)){
  name <- paste0("diff_",col)
  IV_data[name] <- c(NA,diff(IV_data[[col]]))
  # Compute and assign difference
IV_data[[name]] <- c(NA, diff(IV_data[[col]]))

}


IV_data <- na.omit(IV_data)


cor(IV_data$diff_spot_price, IV_data$diff_renewable_generation)


vars_list <-c("diff_spot_price", "diff_renewable_generation",
              "spot_price", "renewable_generation")


adjusted_data <- list()
for (var in vars_list) {
  ts_data <- ts(IV_data[[var]], start = start_date, frequency = frequency)
  # Perform STL decomposition
  stl_fit <- stl(ts_data, s.window = "periodic")
  
  # Extract the seasonally adjusted component
  adjusted_data[[var]] <- seasadj(stl_fit)
}

# Combine the seasonally adjusted data into a dataframe
seasonally_adjusted_df <- as.data.frame(adjusted_data)

cor(seasonally_adjusted_df$diff_spot_price, seasonally_adjusted_df$diff_renewable_generation)

cor(seasonally_adjusted_df$diff_spot_price[0:50], seasonally_adjusted_df$diff_renewable_generation[0:50])


```
Il semble y avoir un effet comme attendu sur le début de la période,
Si l'on prend l'ensemble de l'échantillon, la corrélation est entièrement perdue à cause des derniers gros points à la fin.
On remarque ici que l'instrument et l'endogène ont des tendances donc différencier est important


```{r}

my_plot <- ggplot(IV_data)+
  #geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= T_year_month, color = "Temperature"))+
  geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= diff_spot_price, color = "Elec Price"))+
  geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= diff_renewable_generation/100, color = "Renew Gen"))+
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~. *100, name = "Elec Price")) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Price($)", color = "legend")+
  theme_minimal()

my_plot

```


## Indisponibilités


```{r}
#test4 <- bout_indispo_ENTSOE_data %>% filter(mrid =="uOKJuRKj0o1N8nLBuxbBvw")
save_path_fr <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Data_structuring/output'
setwd(save_path_fr)

monthly_indispo <- read_parquet('monthly_indispo.parquet')
nuclear_monthly_indispo <- read_parquet('nuclear_monthly_indispo.parquet')
unexpected_monthly_indispo <- read_parquet('unexpected_monthly_indispo.parquet')
unexpected_nuclear_monthly_indispo <- read_parquet('unexpected_nuclear_monthly_indispo.parquet')

monthly_indispo <- merge(IV_data %>% select(month, year, datetime),
                   monthly_indispo,
                   by= c("month", "year"))

nuclear_monthly_indispo <- merge(IV_data %>% select(month, year, datetime),
                  nuclear_monthly_indispo,
                   by= c("month", "year"))

unexpected_monthly_indispo <- merge(IV_data %>% select(month, year, datetime),
                   unexpected_monthly_indispo,
                   by= c("month", "year"))
unexpected_nuclear_monthly_indispo <- merge(IV_data %>% select(month, year, datetime),
                   unexpected_nuclear_monthly_indispo,
                   by= c("month", "year"))
```

```{r}

my_plot <- ggplot(IV_data)+
  #geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= T_year_month, color = "Temperature"))+
  geom_line( aes(x= datetime, y= spot_price*100, color = "Elec Price"))+
  geom_line(data= monthly_indispo, aes(x= datetime, y= Unavailable.Capacity, color = "Tot"))+
  geom_line(data= unexpected_monthly_indispo, aes(x= datetime, y= Unavailable.Capacity, color = "Unex Tot"))+
  geom_line(data= nuclear_monthly_indispo, aes(x= datetime, y= Unavailable.Capacity, color = "Nuc Tot"))+
  geom_line(data= unexpected_nuclear_monthly_indispo, aes(x= datetime, y= Unavailable.Capacity, color = "Nuc Unex Tot"))+
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~. /100, name = "Elec Price ($)")) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Unavailability (MWh)", color = "legend")+
  theme_minimal()

my_plot

```


```{r}

cor_data <- merge(unexpected_monthly_indispo, IV_data,
```
